slides.title: Fighting reached Aksum and the Eritrean border
slides.body: ACLED documented forces entering Aksum. Residents of border town Zalambessa told AFP they were “caught in the middle.”

slides.title: A new interim government for Tigray
slides.body: PM Abiy named a six-month caretaker administration on Oct 16, promising elections, Reuters and AFP reported.

slides.title: Ex-fighters register to return to civilian life
slides.body: Hundreds signed up in Mekelle since Oct 14, AFP reported.
